title.narrative: Sub-National Governance Programme II - Implementation through supplier

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Sub-National Governance programme (SNG II) is to improve governance to support poverty reduction. Robust, accountable and transparent public financial management and planning - as well as revenue generation - are essential components in delivering basic services that meet citizens’ needs and the government’s longer-term vision.
